Container.Name: SolidCraft
Container.Overview: Unofficial SolidCraft integration for Unraid, maintained by denara. The CAD application and browser app are developed by bherbruck and the upstream SolidCraft contributors; denara provides the Unraid integration, not the original CAD application.[br][br] SolidCraft features and upstream changes: https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft.[br][br] Additional features provided by this Unraid integration:[br] - Container packaging and Unraid template with persistent server files and resource/security limits.[br] - Authenticated HTTP MCP gateway for local AI clients, with independent CAD sessions, bounded capacity and mandatory project selection into fixed real project folders; existing files remain in place.[br] - Protected live file and session dashboard at /workspace: server-push updates, collapsed project folders and virtual groups for legacy root files, saved model details, PNG thumbnails, original icons, search, filters and downloads; selected projects, opened files, unsaved changes and new drafts.[br] - Explicitly confirmed deletion of individual files and real folders, with revision checks and protection for active MCP projects; virtual legacy groups are never bulk-deleted.[br] - Server-streamed ZIP64 downloads of real folders and subfolders, including empty folders and Unicode names, with bounded memory and conflict/abort handling.[br] - Read-only live model previews for active MCP sessions, including unsaved sketches and solids; bounded shared pictures in memory, calculation status and explicit session-end handling.[br] - Optional remembered browser login for 7 days, 30 days or until logout, independently of MCP authentication; the token is not retained in browser storage.[br] - Shared-file revision checks to reject stale saves and accidental overwrites by parallel clients.[br] - Operational logs for authentication and session allocation/release, with Unraid category colors, icons and the token file location.[br] - Independent hosting of the upstream browser CAD app, with a protected shortcut to open saved models as independent browser copies; browser edits are not automatically written back to server files or MCP sessions.[br][br] Linux amd64 only. Experimental software: latest contains the newest container build that passed modelling, persistence and web checks. Server designs and exports persist under /data/files. The dashboard uses the existing MCP token; it does not edit models.[br][br] This is not an official upstream distribution. Unraid® is a registered trademark of Lime Technology, Inc. Config.Name: Web and MCP port
Config.Description: Web at / ; MCP at /mcp. Nginx can proxy both through this port.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Choose your appdata folder, writable by UID 99 / GID 100. Contains mcp-token and files/.

Config.Name: Allowed origins
Config.Description: Replace this example with your hostname. Comma-separated exact browser origins; clients without Origin can authenticate normally.

Config.Name: Maximum CAD sessions
Config.Description: Each session has its own CAD process and model; 1 to 32.

Config.Name: Idle session seconds
Config.Description: Unsaved models are discarded on expiry. Explicitly save designs you want to keep.

Config.Name: Tool timeout seconds
Config.Description: A timed-out CAD process is ended; operations are never automatically retried.
